$comment: Options for the modbus_tcp connector. Keys map 1:1 to ModbusTcpConnector.__init__ kwargs (spread by main.create_classes) — keep in lockstep with the constructor; tests/test_config.py enforces this. Every scalar also accepts "string" and "null": interpolation runs AFTER validation, so a "${MODBUS_PORT}" declared `number` would fail here as a string. The constructor coerces each one through api/options.py.

host.$comment: The meter, or the TCP gateway fronting several RS-485 slaves. Inside a container this must be an address the container can reach — a meter on the host's LAN is not on the compose network.

port.$comment: 502 is the registered Modbus port; some devices use 5020.

device_id.$comment: Default Modbus unit id. 0 is broadcast, 1-247 are RS-485 slave addresses, and 255 is the Modbus-TCP 'unit id not used' convention. One gateway fronting several slaves addresses each by a different id — override those per device in listener_options.device_id rather than here.

timeout.$comment: Seconds per transaction. With `retries`, this bounds the worst-case in-flight transaction against main's shutdown grace (runtime.shutdown_timeout_seconds, default 10s) — the connector does not override stop(), so a transaction in flight when a shutdown arrives is what decides how long the thread takes to return.

retries.$comment: Attempts per transaction. Defaults to 1, not pymodbus's 3: for a poller the next poll IS the retry, and 3 x timeout is 9s against a 10s shutdown grace.

default_interval.$comment: Poll period in seconds for devices that declare no listener_options.interval.

reconnect_backoff_seconds.$comment: First delay of the reconnect ladder, doubling to max_reconnect_backoff_seconds. A dropped meter is reconnected here rather than by raising: the supervisor's restart budget is for programming faults, and spending it on a nightly gateway drop ends the whole run once the cap is reached.

close_on_error.$comment: Drop the socket after a transport error so the next pass reconnects. True suits a gateway that answers one transaction per connection; set false for a meter that is merely slow.
